module.name: Karmic Soul Journey Model (Individual + Dyadic)
module.scope: Narrative model for soul-direction, karmic lessons, and relationship soul-contract themes using jyotisha indicators often used in Bhrigu-style readings.
module.note: This model outputs interpretive themes (not verifiable facts). Present results as tendencies and reflective prompts.

core_axes.name: Rahu–Ketu axis (direction of evolution)
core_axes.logic: Ketu house = mastered/overdone past patterns; Rahu house = growth edge; interpret in domains of those houses.

core_axes.name: Atmakaraka (soul significator)
core_axes.logic: If provided, Atmakaraka indicates core soul lesson; its house shows arena, dignity shows ease/difficulty.

core_axes.name: Dharma & Moksha houses (9th/12th)
core_axes.logic: 9th shows guiding dharma lineage; 12th shows surrender/letting-go path; planets/lords refine.

core_axes.name: Purva punya & transformation (5th/8th)
core_axes.logic: 5th indicates carried merit/talents; 8th indicates deep transformation karmas and fear-release work.

triggers.suggest: master systems, work ethic, service leadership
learn self-other balance, boundaries, partnership maturity
heal value/attachment patterns, refine love languages
mystic learning; avoid dogma; cultivate inner guru
channel force into constructive action; manage anger
practice surrender; reduce compulsions; spiritual routines
balance desire with generosity; avoid obsession

processing_steps: 1) Identify Rahu and Ketu houses (axis) and map to life domains.
2) If Atmakaraka provided: prioritize its house themes and dignity/afflictions.
4) Match highest-scoring patterns to lesson_catalog triggers.
5) Produce: (a) soul-direction summary (Rahu growth), (b) karmic comfort-zone (Ketu), (c) top 3 lessons, (d) practices.

practices_library.label: Structured routine
practices_library.suggest: steady schedule, service, long walks, minimalist habits

practices_library.label: Mind regulation
practices_library.suggest: journaling, sleep hygiene, water/food balance, meditation

practices_library.label: Constructive action
practices_library.suggest: strength training, martial arts with ethics, breathwork

practices_library.label: Desire clarity
practices_library.suggest: detox from compulsions, retreats, values clarification

soul_contract_checks.name: Node contacts (karmic pull)
soul_contract_checks.logic: If one person’s Rahu/Ketu connects to the other’s luminaries (Sun/Moon) or relationship axis (1/7) or UL, label as strong karmic contract.

soul_contract_checks.name: Saturn bonds (duty & longevity)
soul_contract_checks.logic: Saturn contacts to partner’s 7th lord/Venus/Moon => commitment karma; if heavily afflicted => burden lessons.

soul_contract_checks.name: Jupiter grace (support & forgiveness)
soul_contract_checks.logic: Jupiter protection to partnership indicators => easier resolution; family support; shared values.

soul_contract_checks.name: Venus–Mars polarity (chemistry lessons)
soul_contract_checks.logic: Strong Venus–Mars links => attraction + learning about desire/boundaries; harsh links => volatility training.

soul_contract_checks.name: 8th/12th overlays (deep transformation)
soul_contract_checks.logic: Personal planets landing in partner’s 8th/12th => intense transformation, privacy, healing; requires maturity.

triggers.when: Jupiter or 9th lord strongly supports partner’s 7th/UL
triggers.suggest: growth through mentorship and shared dharma

triggers.when: Strong node contacts + afflictions to Venus/Moon
triggers.suggest: intense attraction; boundaries and stability lessons
obsession risk; practice clarity and pacing

processing_steps: 1) Compute cross-contacts (nodes, Saturn, Jupiter, Venus–Mars) and overlays (1/7/8/12 emphasis) both directions.
2) Score soul_contract_checks and identify top 3 strongest signals.
4) Output: relationship soul-journey summary, core lessons, growth practices, risk flags, and supportive factors.
